_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Wena ule muthu wakwela {player_id} mu Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Chisimbolo chako ni '{symbol}'.
Wena ukwela mizungu yakwe kulemba chisimbolo chako pa mphapha wa 5x5 kutengeneza mstari wa nne.
Mistari inaweza kuwa ya mlalo, wima, au diagonal.
Tumiza mizungu yako kwa kutumia mfumo '[4]' kutia alama seli 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mfumo wa mzungu usio sahihi. Tumia '[cell]' ambapo seli ni 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nambari ya seli isiyo sahihi: {cell}. Lazima iwe kati ya 0 na {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Muthu wakwela {player_id} alifanya mzungu usio sahihi

game_action.placed: Muthu wakwela {player_id} anaweka chisimbolo chake ({symbol}) m'munda ({row}, {col}).
